changes: Portable C bridge replaces Unix-only file-descriptor transport; original upstream sources retained as reference.
Encrypted AES-256-GCM StateStore; per-process native handle registry and cancellable bounded LocalAPI.
Local tsnet fork disables logging side files, backend varroot side files, implicit login and ambient auth/control settings.
SOCKS authentication retained; strict MagicDNS/peer routes and netstack-only TCP, no OS resolver or direct fallback.
Root Go graph includes local integration-test dependencies; upstream graph retained verbatim under upstream/.
Android C ABI accepts java.net.NetworkInterface snapshots with explicit address lists and enumeration errors; RegisterInterfaceGetter avoids forbidden Go netlink without synthetic interfaces.

Android ConnectivityManager default/all-network callbacks update default route metadata and inject netmon changes; callbacks use application context and unregister after node close. No VpnService, route mutation, DNS changes, root or socket protection is used.

Android backend construction scopes upstream TS_LOGS_DIR to the validated app-owned state directory and restores the environment under a constructor lock: NewLocalBackend eagerly resolves a log directory even when socket statistics are unavailable. No HOME/TMPDIR override, log upload or plaintext side store is enabled; desktop/iOS directory policy is unchanged.
